intro: Lazur is an AI assistant for event planners on Mac. Hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask about the email, sheet or bid on screen. It answers out loud, points at what matters and drafts text for you to check. It does not send, click or change anything for you.
tldr: Lazur lives in the notch of your Mac. Hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask about anything on screen.
It answers out loud, points at cells and emails, and drafts text that you check and send.
It does not send emails, click buttons or edit your budget for you.

blocks.text: Where an event planner's day actually goes

No primary study measures how event planners split their workday. The numbers below come from nearby groups, such as office workers and venue sourcing surveys. Use them as a guide, not as a measure of your own week.

The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics describes the job as coordination. Planners meet clients, choose sites, request bids and negotiate contracts with vendors. They also arrange rooms, transport, food and AV. They review bills, approve payments and survey attendees. The BLS page does not say how much of that happens on a computer.

Computer work is the part the research can measure, at least for office workers. Microsoft's 2025 study found the average employee receives 117 emails and 153 Teams messages a day. The same workers get interrupted about 275 times a day. The study covered knowledge workers in general, so read it as a pattern, not a planner's log.

Asana's Anatomy of Work research says about 60% of a knowledge worker's time goes to work about work. That means status updates, chasing replies and re-explaining decisions. The article gives yearly hours for that work: 352 hours talking about work, 209 hours on duplicative work and 103 hours in unnecessary meetings. It does not state the survey year, so treat the hours as rough.
Venue sourcing and bids: the afternoons that disappear

Sourcing is where many planners lose whole afternoons. Cvent's 2026 Global Planner Sourcing Report surveyed 1,650 planners. It found 58% spend up to five hours using technology to source each event. Cvent sells sourcing software, so read the number as a vendor survey, not a neutral audit.

Deadlines make it worse. Cvent's statistics page says 80% of planners want venue RFP responses in under four days. A bid that arrives on Monday may need your answer by Thursday. Track who owes you what, and when, before you open the next proposal.
A bad sourcing afternoon looks like this. You open several venue PDFs, copy each rate into a sheet and chase the one that left out its capacity figure. Each step is small. Together they fill the day.
Ways to use Lazur on a venue proposal

items: Hold ⌥ ⌘ over a venue PDF and ask for the minimum spend. Lazur answers out loud.
Ask Lazur to point at the capacity line, so you see it before you read the whole proposal.
Hold fn to dictate your comparison notes. The text lands at your cursor, clean and formatted.
Ask Lazur to draft a follow-up asking for the missing capacity figure in writing.

blocks.text: Lazur reads what is on your screen. It can misread a scanned PDF, a faded table or merged cells. Check every rate and capacity against the original before it goes into a contract. A wrong number in a contract stays with you.
Email and chat: keep the thread without losing the afternoon

Email is the other big drain. Caterers, florists, AV crews and your client all write to the same inbox. Lazur helps with the reply, not the sending. In Gmail, hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask what the caterer wants. Then ask for a draft. Lazur types it into the compose window at your cursor.

blocks.title: Lazur never presses Send
blocks.text: Lazur does not click Send, Reply or Schedule. You press the button. Read every figure and date in a draft before it leaves your Mac.

Templates handle the requests you send every month. Vendor deposit reminders are a good example. For a setup for that, see [Gmail for event planners](/for/event-planners/gmail). It covers templates, scheduled sends and using Lazur for RSVPs.

Chat moves faster. Vendors ping you in a channel while your client messages you directly. A deposit deadline can slip between the two. If Slack stops alerting you, fix it before the next venue reply. The steps are in [how to fix Slack notifications on Mac](/how-to/fix-missing-notifications-in-slack).
Spreadsheets for budgets, run of show and guest lists

Budgets, run of show and guest lists all live in spreadsheets. Microsoft's 2023 Work Trend Index found that Excel took 18% of creation time, ahead of Word at 10% and PowerPoint at 8%. The study covered knowledge workers, not planners. It shows which tools people create with, not which tools planners pick.

blocks.text: Numbers ships with templates that include tables, charts and formulas. Choose File > New to pick one. To send a copy to someone who uses Excel, click Share in the toolbar, then Export and Send. Numbers 15.4 for Mac needs macOS 26 or later, so check your system first.

In Google Sheets, a long budget is hard to scan. Freeze the top row so the headers stay in view. The steps are in [freeze the top row in Google Sheets](/how-to/freeze-the-top-row-in-google-sheets). For unpaid deposits only, add a filter to the range. See [add a filter to a range in Google Sheets](/how-to/add-a-filter-to-a-range-in-google-sheets).
Questions to ask Lazur in a budget sheet

items: Which line is over the approved amount? Lazur points at it.
What does this formula do? Lazur explains it in plain words.
How do I make this column a dropdown? Lazur walks you through it, one click at a time.
Draft a note to the AV crew about the rows I highlighted.

blocks.text: Sheets that hold personal details need care. Hide the rows you should not share before you ask for help. The steps are in [hide rows and columns in Google Sheets](/how-to/hide-rows-and-columns-in-google-sheets).
Outlook for Mac: check your version before you rely on it

Some planners still run legacy Outlook for Mac. Microsoft's support page says legacy Outlook stops working against Exchange Online mailboxes starting October 2026. That date has now passed. Open Outlook and check which version you run before you count on it for vendor mail.

To switch, turn off the Legacy Outlook toggle, or update through Help > Check for Updates or the App Store. Microsoft's release notes list 16.114.3, released October 27, 2026, as the most recent Office for Mac release. Update once, then send a test message to yourself.
A worked example: answering one caterer follow-up

Here is one follow-up from start to finish. The caterer's email asks for a final headcount and a dietary breakdown by Friday. The numbers sit in your guest list sheet. Lazur helps with the reply. You check the numbers and send it.

items: Hold ⌥ ⌘ over the email and ask what the caterer needs. Lazur answers out loud.
Hold fn and dictate the headcount and dietary notes. The text lands at your cursor.
Ask Lazur to draft a short reply in a warm, firm tone. It types the draft into the compose window.
Compare every figure with your sheet. Fix anything that does not match, then send it yourself.

blocks.text: The check takes longer than the drafting, and it should. Give that part your full attention before anything leaves your Mac.
Mistakes planners make with an AI assistant

items: Trusting a total without checking the sheet. Lazur reads what is on screen, and merged cells can fool it.
Pasting client personal data into a tool before you check your employer's rules.
Expecting Lazur to click through a vendor portal. It guides you, and you do the clicking.
Letting a draft go out because it sounds right. Read the dates, names and money.
Dictating a client name without checking the spelling. Add it to your personal dictionary first.

blocks.title: Check the rules first
blocks.text: Event planners often hold client contracts, guest lists and payment details. Follow your employer's rules on that data before you ask any AI tool to read it.
Privacy and client data on your Mac

Lazur listens and looks at the screen only while you hold the shortcut. Audio and the screenshot go to AI providers so Lazur can answer you. They are not stored. Content is never used to train AI models. Lazur keeps a memory of what you asked and did, on your Mac.

This page makes no compliance claims. Your agency, venue or client may have data rules that are stricter than ours. Ask before you share a screen that shows guest names, addresses or payment details. If the answer is no, hide those rows first, then ask for help.

Pick one repeat task, such as the weekly vendor follow-up. Do that task with Lazur before you try anything else.

Check [pricing](/pricing) for plan details before you commit.

faq.question: What is an AI assistant for event planners on Mac?
faq.answer: Lazur is a voice assistant that lives in the notch of your Mac. Hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask about anything on screen, and it answers out loud. It helps with replies, sheets and steps in the apps you already use. It does not act for you.

faq.question: Does Lazur send emails or edit my spreadsheet?
faq.answer: No. Lazur drafts and types text, points at cells and walks you through each click. It does not click Send or change a cell. You make the change and press the button yourself.

faq.question: Does Lazur work in Google Sheets and Gmail?
faq.answer: Lazur sees your screen in any app, so it works with Google Sheets and Gmail open in a browser. Ask it where a setting lives, and it points at it or walks you through it one click at a time.

faq.question: Is Lazur available on Windows?
faq.answer: Not yet. Lazur runs on macOS, on both Apple silicon and Intel Macs. Windows is planned, but it is not available.

faq.question: Can I trust Lazur with client data?
faq.answer: Lazur listens and looks only while you hold the shortcut. Audio and screenshots go to AI providers to answer you, and they are not stored. This page makes no compliance claims. Follow your employer's rules on client data before you share anything.

faq.question: Which Outlook do I need for Mac?
faq.answer: Check which version you open. Microsoft says legacy Outlook for Mac stops working against Exchange Online mailboxes starting October 2026. Update through Help > Check for Updates or the App Store.

faq.question: Can Lazur dictate into a vendor email?
faq.answer: Yes. Hold fn and talk, and clean text lands at your cursor in any app. You can add names to a personal dictionary so the spelling comes out right. Check the text before you send it.

faq.question: How do I try Lazur?
faq.answer: Download it from the download page and open it once. The trial starts the first time you open the app, and it needs no credit card. Plan details are on the pricing page.

faq.question: Does Lazur replace my event planning software?
faq.answer: No. It sits beside the tools you already use, such as Google Sheets, Gmail and Slack. Your contracts, bookings and client records stay where they are.
